The '''Jedi Temple''' was a facility built by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]] after the discovery of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AA" />
